title: solidago virgaurea subsp. centiflora
intro: Solidago virgaurea subsp. centiflora, commonly known as Goldenrod, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, respiratory infections, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Goldenrod include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Goldenrod include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
